name: Fire Nova Bomb
primary:
A fire bomb that bursts into a wide ring of flame.
A projectile flies where you look and explodes in a 5-block radius on hit. Effects:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ fire + 2.5 ❤ arcane (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 12 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Arcane instability: −0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 6 s
self_description:
An explosion around you with a 3.5-block radius, hitting you as well:
• Damage 2.5 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 12 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Arcane instability: −0.5 ❤ every 2 s for 6 s
